hints.title: Find Closest Point on Rectangle
hints.text: Clamp the circle center coordinates (xCenter, yCenter) to the bounds [x1, x2] and [y1, y2].

hints.title: Distance to Closest Point
hints.text: Let closest_x = max(x1, min(xCenter, x2)) and closest_y = max(y1, min(yCenter, y2)).

hints.title: Check Radius Boundary
hints.text: The circle and rectangle overlap if the Euclidean distance from circle center to (closest_x, closest_y) is at most radius.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def checkOverlap(self, radius: int, xCenter: int, yCenter: int, x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int) -> bool:
        closest_x = max(x1, min(xCenter, x2))
        closest_y = max(y1, min(yCenter, y2))
        dx = xCenter - closest_x
        dy = yCenter - closest_y
        return dx * dx + dy * dy <= radius * radius
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sampling points on the perimeter or interior is imprecise and computationally wasteful.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Clamping gives the closest point in O(1) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate projects circle center onto axis-aligned bounding box and compares squared distance.
complexity.notes: Use squared distance to avoid floating point square roots.
